name: LDC

date: 2026-04-27至04-30（会议日期；精确上线日未核实）
authors: Kiran Hombal, Henry Zhu, Shreesha G. Bhat, Neil Kaushikkar, Ramnatthan Alagappan, Aishwarya Ganesan
